display.purpose: Wordmark, dialog titles - angular technical face, HUD character.

body.purpose: Field labels, buttons, general UI text.

label.purpose: Numeric/data values - zoom %, thresholds, URLs, model names.

shadows.name: panel
shadows.purpose: Reserved for chrome that could visually float; sparingly used.

shadows.name: pop
shadows.purpose: The loaded canvas image and modal/popover surfaces.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default transition for background-color/border-color/color state changes across buttons, fields, tool icons.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call-to-action (Translate All, Save Story). Near-black text on the accent fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #f6821f; color: #17110a; padding: 6px 14px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; border-radius: 7px; border: none; transition: background-color 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #ff9843; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f6821f; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary actions (Upload, Export, Clear, Preview OCR). Transparent with a hairline border.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: hsl(28 10% 62%); border: 1px solid #2a2a32; padding: 6px 11px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; border-radius: 7px; transition: background-color 120ms ease, color 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: #eceef2; border-color: #3a3a44; background: #1e1e24; }

components.name: Tool Rail Icon Button
components.description: 36x36 icon-only button in the left tool rail. Active state is a tinted fill, not an outline.
components.html: <button class="ds-tool-btn ds-tool-btn--active"><svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.75" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M5 3v17l4.5-4 2.5 5.5 2.4-1.1L12 15h5.5L5 3Z"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-tool-btn { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 7px; color: hsl(28 10% 62%); background: transparent; transition: background-color 120ms ease, color 120ms ease; } .ds-tool-btn:hover { background: #1e1e24; color: #eceef2; } .ds-tool-btn--active { background: rgba(246, 130, 31, 0.14); color: #ff9843; }

components.name: Field Select
components.description: Standard dropdown used throughout the right dock. Recessed (sunken) fill distinguishes it as editable.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: hsl(28 10% 62%); } .ds-field-input { width: 100%; appearance: none; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid #2a2a32; background: #0d0d0f; color: #eceef2; padding: 6px 10px; font-size: 13px; transition: border-color 120ms ease; } .ds-field-input:focus { border-color: #f6821f; outline: none; }

components.name: Collapsible Section
components.description: Native <details>/<summary> settings group used in the right dock (Translation, Detection, Inpainting, ...). Hand-drawn chevron, no icon glyph.
components.css: .ds-section { border-bottom: 1px solid #2a2a32; } .ds-section-summary { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 11px 14px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.03em; text-transform: uppercase; color: hsl(28 10% 62%); cursor: pointer; list-style: none; } .ds-section-summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; } .ds-section-summary::before { content: ''; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-right: 1.5px solid hsl(28 8% 42%); border-bottom: 1.5px solid hsl(28 8% 42%); transform: rotate(-45deg); transition: transform 140ms ease; } .ds-section[open] > .ds-section-summary::before { transform: rotate(45deg); } .ds-section-body { padding: 4px 14px 16px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; }

narrative.overview: Panelglot reads like a field-survey instrument, not a consumer web app: a near-black workspace with orange topographic contour lines drifting behind every panel, as if the canvas were a terrain map the tool is scanning for text. The aesthetic exists because the product's job is literally detection and mapping - finding text regions on a page and plotting their coordinates - so the chrome plays the same game the pipeline does. It is a tool for sustained, close-up work, so density and legibility win over whitespace or decoration. The interface commits fully to dark: there is no light mode, because the product's use scene has no reason to want one.
keyCharacteristics: Void-black base with a live orange-on-charcoal contour map drifting behind opaque panels
One accent color, used sparingly and only for action/state, never decoration
Dense, collapsible tool panels (Clip Studio Paint / Photoshop density)
Every icon is a hand-drawn single-stroke SVG; nothing borrowed from an icon font or emoji

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Survey Orange is the only saturated color in the system. Reach for weight, size, or position before reaching for a new color.

rules.name: The Warm Gray Rule
rules.body: Secondary/tertiary text is hue-tinted toward the accent (hsl(28 ...)), never flat neutral gray.

rules.name: The Mono-For-Numbers Rule
rules.body: Any precisely-read numeric value renders in the mono font with tabular-nums.

rules.name: The Flat-Chrome Rule
rules.body: Docks, bars, and rails never carry a shadow; depth is reserved for the canvas image and true overlays.

dos: Do reach for the CSS custom properties for every color; never hardcode a hex value that matches an existing token.
Do keep Survey Orange to primary actions, active/selected state, and verified/success-adjacent signals only.
Do use the mono font with tabular-nums for any numeric value the user reads precisely.
Do author new icons as inline SVG through Icon.vue's path map, matching the 24px/1.75 stroke-weight convention.
Do keep chrome flat and reserve shadow for the canvas image and true overlays.
donts: Don't introduce a second saturated accent color.
Don't use emoji or an icon-font glyph anywhere in the product UI.
Don't add a shadow to ordinary chrome.
Don't use plain neutral gray for secondary/tertiary text.
Don't round corners past 11px for emphasis.
